subject: gk
question:
Which of the following duties has been NOT prescribed by the Indian Constitution as Fundamental Duties?

1. To defend the country

2. To pay income tax

3. To cast the vote in election

4. To safeguard the public property
solution:
The correct answer is __**2) 2 and 3 both**__.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__

 
• The Indian Constitution prescribes certain duties to its citizens known as Fundamental Duties.
 
• Among the given options, "To pay income tax" and "To cast the vote in election" are not listed as Fundamental Duties in the Indian Constitution.
 
• The Fundamental Duties are listed in Article 51A of the Indian Constitution.
